details:
In older versions, i know the avatar miniature preview will updated what you have now using on yourself.

But click on try-out avatars (like on vket booths) i noticed when i open the avatar page, the preview is not updated and still show earlier used avatar.

This problem is not seen in earlier versions (old Menu system works correctly) but this newer Menu system at version 1271 seems forgot update it immediately.

It will show correct miniature if i click on other avatar group tab. But it's not nice done, kinda less good result. We cant also check immediately avatar details this way.

You cant also favorite the just clicked try-out avatar, because there is still wrong avatar.

I know if you click on other avatars, it will show own preview. The point is more if you picked another avatar on world, it should show preview of it when open avatar page, and buttons below should give me option to check details or favorite it. Extra clicks around feels bit weird to show correct avatar miniature. It just doesn't feel right what is supposed (from my years experience with menu system). I will see it as update bug because i am forced to click around to get correct miniature.

It's small "less nice" bug, it should showed immediately correct miniature, not previous used.

I suggest fix this "not nice done" bug so it works what is supposed. :)
title: [1271] Avatar miniature not updated correctly after click on try-out avatar.
